Growth of WT Rpom
```{R}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)

# Load OD600 values from Gen5 plate reader
OD600 <- fread('2022_12_12_Plate_2_DSS3_homarine_mutants.csv', header=T)

# Convert time to seconds and hours
OD600$TimeS <- period_to_seconds(lubridate::hms(OD600$Time))
OD600$TimeH <- OD600$TimeS / 3600

# Define the blank/control well
control_col <- "C1"  # Background control well

# List of sample wells
sample_wells <- c("B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B6")

# Ensure the control column exists
if (control_col %in% colnames(OD600)) {
  # Subtract the background OD600 from each sample well, ensuring non-negative values
  OD600[, (sample_wells) := lapply(.SD, function(x) pmax(x - get(control_col), 0)), .SDcols = sample_wells]
} else {
  stop("Control well (C1) not found in the dataset.")
}

# Convert to long format for ggplot
OD600_long <- OD600 %>%
  select(TimeH, all_of(sample_wells)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -TimeH, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "OD600")

# Compute summary statistics (mean & standard deviation)
OD600_summary <- OD600_long %>%
  group_by(TimeH) %>%
  summarise(mean_OD = mean(OD600, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_OD = sd(OD600, na.rm = TRUE))

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(OD600_summary, aes(x = TimeH, y = mean_OD)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_OD - sd_OD, ymax = mean_OD + sd_OD), 
              fill = "#E87D94", alpha = 0.3) +  # Shaded area
  geom_line(color = "#017F75", size = 1) +  # Main line
  labs(x = "", y = "Growth (OD600)", title = "DSS-3 WT") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5)) +  # Set the same Y-axis scale for all plots
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.1)
  )

# Display the plot
print(p)
# 
# # Save the plot
# ggsave("Growth_WT_plot.png", plot = p, width = 3, height = 2, dpi = 300)
```

N-methyl-glutamate dehydrogenase mutants
```{R}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

# Read the dataset
OD600 <- fread('2024_4_12_growth_curves_NMGAD_SPO3191_Homi_NMGA.csv', header = TRUE)

# Convert Time column to seconds and then to hours
OD600$Time <- period_to_seconds(hms(OD600$Time)) / 3600

# Function to subtract the lowest value from each column
subtract_min <- function(data) {
  min_values <- apply(data, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE)  # Calculate the minimum value for each column
  data <- data - min_values  # Subtract the minimum value from each element in the column
  return(data)
}

# Identify numeric columns except columns 1 and 2
numeric_cols <- names(OD600)[sapply(OD600, is.numeric) & !(names(OD600) %in% c("TimeS", "Time"))]

# Subtract the lowest value from each column
OD600[, (numeric_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) {
  if(length(x) > 1) {
    x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    x
  }
}), .SDcols = numeric_cols]


SPO1588_Hom4 <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = OD600, aes(x = Time, y = B6, 
                              group = 1, color = "#E87D94")) +
  geom_line(data = OD600, aes(x = Time, y = C6, 
                              group = 1, color = "#E87D94")) +
  geom_line(data = OD600, aes(x = Time, y = D6, 
                              group=1,), color = "#E87D94") +
  geom_line(data = OD600, aes(x = Time, y = E6, 
                              group=1), color = "#E87D94") +
  geom_line(data = OD600, aes(x = Time, y = F6, 
                              group=1), color = "#E87D94") +  
  geom_line(data = OD600, aes(x = Time, y = G6, 
                              group=1), color = "#E87D94") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  labs(x=" ", y=" ") +  
  ggtitle('SPO1588 HOM4') + scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ylim(0,0.05)

  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ylim(0,0.05)

Gplot <- ggarrange(SPO1588_Hom4,SPO1585_Hom4,
                   SPO1588_NMGA, SPO1585_NMGA, 
                   DSS3_NMGA, DSS3_Hom4,
                   ncol =2, nrow =3) 

annotate_figure(Gplot,
                top = text_grob("Growth of mgd mutants", 
                                face ='bold', size = 14))
```
